pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided polygons with smooth, graduated pixel transitions at the boundaries. Patch size is heterogeneous, with larger spatial areas on the lower flank and significantly smaller, more densely packed regions toward the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space with multiple 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness, generally wider on the lower flank and narrowing between the smaller patches on the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the dorsal line of the neck, characterized by dark, densely packed bristles against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Numerous localized, dark circular spots of textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation are visible within the larger primary patches on the upper flank and mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high density of small, dark, circular lesions or pitting is present across the flank and neck, suggesting active skin disruption or parasitic presence.
other_distinctive_markers: A 'double-patterning' effect where individual primary brown patches contain internal, darker focal spots of pigment.
